title: Concentrated Liquidity Provision: a Reinforcement Learning Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2608.19389v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated market makers (AMMs) are a cornerstone of decentralised finance (DeFi). Constant product markets with concentrated liquidity, such as UniswapV3, are now a well-established design. In these markets, liquidity providers (LPs) face a sequential decision problem: they must decide when to rebalance their positions and which price ranges to allocate capital to as market conditions evolve. We formulate dynamic liquidity provision as a stochastic impulse control problem and use reinforcement learning (RL) to solve it, focusing on providing interpretable solutions. We show that learned policies exhibit rich state-dependent behaviour, allocating liquidity according to mispricing, rebalancing costs, uncertainty, inventory exposure, and heterogeneous risk preferences. translated_title: 集中流动性提供：一种强化学习视角
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19389v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：自动化做市商（AMMs）是去中心化金融（DeFi）的基石。具有集中流动性的恒定乘积市场，如UniswapV3，现已是一种成熟的设计。在这些市场中，流动性提供者（LPs）面临一个序贯决策问题：他们必须决定何时重新平衡其头寸，以及随着市场条件变化，将资本分配到哪些价格区间。我们将动态流动性提供建模为一个随机脉冲控制问题，并使用强化学习（RL）来解决它，重点关注提供可解释的解决方案。我们表明，学习到的策略表现出丰富的状态依赖行为，根据错误定价、重新平衡成本、不确定性、库存暴露和异质性风险偏好来分配流动性。这些行为有助于压缩损益（PnL）分布的左尾，并在高不确定性下避免灾难性结果。最后，我们对RL进行了基准测试。
tldr: 该论文通过强化学习解决集中流动性提供中的动态决策问题，学习策略能根据市场状态优化流动性分配，有效降低风险并提升收益表现。
en_tdlr: This paper addresses dynamic liquidity provision via reinforcement learning, where learned policies optimize capital allocation based on market states, effectively mitigating risks and improving performance.
